title: Backend Python developer
text: We are looking for a backend developer with strong Python and Django experience. You will design REST APIs and work with PostgreSQL. Docker and Redis are an advantage.

title: Data scientist
text: Join our data team as a data scientist. Required: Python, Machine Learning, pandas and scikit-learn. Experience with statistics and SQL is an advantage.

title: DevOps engineer
text: DevOps engineer to own our Kubernetes clusters and CI/CD pipelines. Docker and Linux are a must; Terraform and AWS are an advantage.

title: Embedded software engineer
text: Embedded software engineer: C++ on microcontrollers with an RTOS. Embedded systems experience required; debugging with UART and SPI is an advantage.

title: C# .NET developer
text: Full stack C# developer for ASP.NET applications on .NET with SQL Server. Azure and Angular are an advantage.
